notes.title: CRANONIMOUS Strikes: CyberRush's First Boss Battle Unleashed!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743303/ca6735b7102a8cc4c3bdcf5058992b16a864b504.png

CyberRush fans, get ready for an electrifying challenge! 
We're excited to announce the introduction of CRANONIMOUS, the first boss in CyberRush. 

This powerful enemy brings new challenges, requiring you to dodge attacks, strategize on the fly, and maintain your speed in a high-stakes battle.

Prepare yourself, hone your skills, and face off against CRANONIMOUS. Can you emerge victorious in this ultimate test? Jump into CyberRush now to find out!

Patch Notes

 Added first boss battle
 Fixed settings being reverted on restart
 Fixed camera switch bug during intro sequence
